name: odin
description: ODIN - advanced code agent with diagram-first engineering and atomic commit workflows for surgical precision in software development
author: cognitive-glitch

interface.shortDescription: Diagram-first engineering and atomic commit workflows
interface.longDescription: ODIN turns the agent into a surgical code agent: architecture, data-flow, concurrency, memory and optimization diagrams before code; AST-based edits over text edits; one concern per atomic commit; and source-verified dependency work instead of recall.
